document_pack.title: Citizens Updates Hurricane Ian Estimates
document_pack.why_it_matters: Citizens' own Hurricane Ian estimate update ties the carrier to the event and notes claim activity, litigation costs, and loss adjustment expenses.

common_defenses: Flood or storm-surge exclusion positioned against wind-created openings and wind-driven rain facts.
Limited scope of repair or ACV payment based on the carrier's estimate rather than full exterior and interior documentation.
Supplemental-damage documentation and timing disputes after a major-event adjustment.
rebuttal_angles: Compare the official NHC and NWS Ian chronology to photographs, repair invoices, and opening-created water-intrusion evidence.
Use Citizens' claim-process guidance to test whether inspection, claim review, supplement review, and written explanation steps are documented in the claim file.
Separate flood/surge allocation from covered wind and wind-driven rain causation before accepting a blended water-damage denial rationale.
Use the Citizens Ian estimate update only as event and claim-volume context, not as proof of this insured's claim amount.
